description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Environment_Manager, which manages system environment checks for the Revive Adserver upgrade process, including PHP environment validation, file permissions, and system configuration.

classes.name: OA_Environment_Manager
classes.description: Manages environment validation including PHP configuration, file permissions, and system readiness for upgrade.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes environment info, expected file permissions, and PHP configuration parameters.

methods.name: checkSystem
methods.description: Performs comprehensive system checks and returns environment info.

methods.name: getAllInfo
methods.description: Gathers PHP info, file permission errors, file integrity info, and cookie info.

methods.name: getCookieInfo
methods.description: Checks if cookies are enabled and session cookies are present.

methods.name: getPHPInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current PHP environment details including version, extensions, and configuration limits.

methods.name: getFileIntegInfo
methods.description: Returns file integrity info; currently returns false.

methods.name: buildFilePermArrayItem
methods.description: Creates an array representing a file permission check item.

methods.name: checkFilePermission
methods.description: Recursively checks if a file or directory is writable.

methods.name: getFilePermissionErrors
methods.description: Checks all expected files/directories for write permissions and returns errors.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory is writable, with Windows-specific handling.

methods.name: checkCritical
methods.description: Performs critical system checks including PHP environment and file permissions.

methods.name: _checkCriticalPHP
methods.description: Validates PHP version, extensions, memory limits, and timeout settings.

methods.name: checkOriginalMemory
methods.description: Checks if the original PHP memory limit is sufficient.

methods.name: _checkCriticalFilePermissions
methods.description: Checks for critical file permission issues.

methods.name: _checkCriticalFiles
methods.description: Placeholder for additional critical file checks.
